description: 8-DI + 8-DO mixed I/O ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address. DI ch0-1 support event counter mode; DO ch0-1 support pulse output mode only. FC01: doStatus ch0-7, diCounterStatus ch0-1, diCounterOverflowFlagClear ch0-1, doPulseStatus ch0-1. FC02: diStatus ch0-7, diMode ch0-7 (0=DI 1=Counter), doMode ch0-7 (0=DO 1=Pulse), diCounterOverflowFlag ch0-1. FC03: diCounterValue ch0-1 u64 (rel 0-7), doStatusAll (rel 8), doPulseCount ch0-1 u64 (rel 9-16), doPulseOnWidth ch0-1 (rel 17-18, unit 500us), doPulseOffWidth ch0-1 (rel 19-20, unit 500us), doPulseStatusAll (rel 21), diCounterStatusAll (rel 22), diCounterOverflowFlagClearAll (rel 23). FC04: diStatusAll, diCounterOverflowFlagAll, diModeAll, doModeAll.
